impact_scope.description: S1 adds a public Netpbm image decoder implementing the base image_decoder interface; no corresponding declaration exists in S0.
S1 introduces decoding of binary Netpbm P5 and P6 inputs, including headers, dimensions, maximum value, comments, and pixel data.
Exercising the new decoder requires compiling/enabling the Netpbm module, while H0 enables only BASE and BMP.

evidence: S0 has no matching Netpbm decoder declaration or production file.
Because the scoped Netpbm entry points and input format do not exist in S0, H0 has no S0 obligation to enable, instantiate, or invoke them.

gap_after.type: missing exposure of new decoder and input format
evidence: S1 adds std/netpbm/decode_netpbm.wuffs with a public decoder implementing base.image_decoder and public decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, decode_frame, and restart_frame operations.
H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__BMP, instantiates wuffs_bmp__decoder, and passes only that decoder to fuzz_image_decoder; it neither enables nor instantiates the new Netpbm decoder.
Consequently, H0 cannot route fuzz-controlled P5/P6 Netpbm bytes through the new header parsing, frame decoding, or restart state transitions.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must enable the Netpbm module and add an entry or selection path that initializes a Netpbm decoder and supplies fuzz input through its base.image_decoder call sequence.
evidence: The decoder and its public entry points are newly introduced in S1 and absent from S0.
H0's compile-time module selection explicitly includes BASE and BMP only.
H0's sole decoder construction is wuffs_bmp__decoder__initialize, so the existing generic fuzz_image_decoder helper has no Netpbm decoder instance to exercise.

reason: The stable scope is the newly added public Netpbm decoder and P5/P6 input semantics. That scope did not exist in S0, so there was no prior gap. In S1 it exists but remains unreachable under unchanged H0 because H0 compiles and instantiates only BMP. This creates concrete compile-time enablement, decoder-construction, and input-routing obligations, yielding NEW under the truth table.
